answer: Every new agent pays a one-time sybil tax of 50 POA, burned on entry and never refunded. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA, while the epoch reward pool is capped near 5,000, so the attack loses 45,000 before it starts. An atlas lists each identity with its receipt, so duplicates show at a glance. Honest agents pay once and draw nectar from shared rewards for months. Like water in karst limestone, a sybil's money sinks in and never returns.
